item.title: Lancers take care of Nevada Union
item.description: The anticipated all-Manteca Unified semifinal is on. East Union did its part Friday in a postponed Sac-Joaquin Section Division III quarterfinal against seventh-seeded Nevada Union, rolling to a 68-48 victory. The Miners from Grass Valley were originally scheduled to visit Dalben Center on Thursday, but extreme weather conditions prevented them from traveling.

item.title: SB 872 is the ideal prescription for Sacramento’s myopic tunnel vision
item.description: California is sinking. Well, not all of it. Some of it is rising.

item.title: Earliest 2026 SSJID irrigation season start is on March 18
item.description: The South San Joaquin Irrigation District board when they meet Tuesday is expected to delay the start of the 2026 irrigation season until March 18.

item.title: MANTECA MAKES MOVE TO ENGAGE MORE RESIDENTS
item.description: The three city functions that engage the most Manteca residents on any given day — recreation, parks, and transit — are being combined into one department.

item.title: Breakfast for Dinner March 5 benefits Thomas Toy Center
item.description: The second annual Breakfast for Dinner benefitting the Thomas Toy Center takes place Thursday, March 5.

item.title: Developer aims for supermarket on Louise Avenue
item.description: A developer is pushing plans for another supermarket as work is well underway on what will be Manteca’s first new supermarkets opening in 27 years.

item.title: Dhaliwal sees Roth Road extension to Highway 99 as a critical road project
item.description: Sonny Dhaliwal views the extension of Roth Road to Highway 99as a way to secure good paying jobs, address present and future truck traffic issues, and improve the quality of life for Manteca and Lathrop residents.

item.title: 3 second-half goals lead to section 3-peat for Ripon Christian
item.description: SACRAMENTO — Down by a goal to No. 3 Stone Ridge Christian at halftime, top-seeded Ripon Christian bounced back to earn its third-consecutive Sac-Joaquin Section Division VI girls soccer championship 3-1 at Hughes Stadium.

item.title: Top-3 finishes at Masters send Manteca duo to state tourney
item.description: STOCKTON — Manteca High’s Liliana Rios and Breanna Bragg will advance to the California State Wrestling Championships on Thursday in Bakersfield as a result of their top-five finishes Saturday in the Sac-Joaquin Section Masters Wrestling Championships at Adventist Health Arena.

item.title: Heartbreak for EU in SJS final
item.description: The East Union Lancers’ quest for a second Sac-Joaquin Section title ended in heartbreak Saturday night at Sacramento City College in a hard-fought 1-0 loss to defending champion Liberty Ranch of Galt in the Division IV final.
